claims.claim: CME lists the standard COMEX Silver futures contract unit as 5,000 troy ounces and identifies the contract code.
COMEX Rule 112 sets silver futures delivery quantity, tolerance, fineness, approved brand, and delivery rules.
CME describes precious metals warrants as the delivery instrument and explains notice, assignment, transfer, and load out.
CME’s product guide describes an intent, invoicing, and delivery cycle for physically delivered metal contracts.
